result.summary: Several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, an incomplete category chip row, a suspicious '-100%' badge, and cut-off content at the bottom of the feed.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on detail/hover so names are fully readable.

issues.description: A '-100%' badge appears on the pizza card, which looks like a broken or incorrect discount label.
issues.suggestion: Show a clear promo format (e.g. '100% off' or '-€X') only when valid; hide or fix bad discount data.

issues.description: Category chips row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' and a clipped next chip), with no clear affordance that more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/scroll hint or ensure horizontal scroll is obvious so users know more categories are available.

issues.description: The lower pizza card is heavily cropped by the bottom of the viewport/nav, so the offer is hard to evaluate.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding above the tab bar so cards aren’t obscured, or ensure the feed scrolls fully into view.

issues.description: Delivery time labels sit as white pills over food images and can reduce visual clarity of the imagery.
issues.suggestion: Increase pill contrast/shadow or place meta info below the image for cleaner cards.
